config.journeyrecruits.title: Journey Recruits Settings
config.journeyrecruits.nameShowMaxZoom.t: At which zoom level the state name appears. Higher value means the label is visible when the map is more zoomed out. Typically 1–5.
config.journeyrecruits.labelFontScaleFul: Label font size on the fullscreen map
Scale of the state name font on the fullscreen map (2.5 = default, 2–4 = larger).
config.journeyrecruits.labelFontScaleMin: Label font size on the minimap
Scale of the state name font on the minimap (1.5 = default, 2–4 = larger).
config.journeyrecruits.showLabelOnMinima: Show the state name on the minimap in the corner of the screen (if supported by JourneyMap).
